vehicle.notes: UK RHD. BMW left/right (LH/RH) = the vehicle's own left/right (left = UK nearside/passenger side, right = offside/driver side). Pre-LCI 2019-2022; LCI facelift from 2022. M Sport and SE/Sport/Luxury bumpers and grilles differ, and so do headlamp types (LED / adaptive LED AHL / laser); those numbers are variants and are never auto-filled. Numbers are from web-search result titles/summaries of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked. Research was cut short when the shared web-search budget ran out, so this file covers the front end only (see report). Verify every number by VIN.
